column1: # jespersen's own French word list (CC0): words respelt for what the spelling rules would miss. One
# per line: the word in lower case, a tab, its respelling in letters the rules read as the word is
# said. A doubled consonant and a final e keep a final consonant said (fils fisse, bus busse);
# the rules drop a final s, x, z, t, d and p, say a final c, f, l and r, read -er as é and -ent of
